entities.evidence: Chinese financial media (Sina Finance, 36Kr, 10jqka) and Goldman Sachs' own Greater China site consistently use 高盛 / 高盛集团.

clip_research.source_claim: Goldman Sachs top executives are poised to collect special bonuses totaling more than $500 million, one of the biggest payouts the firm has ever awarded.
clip_research.public_baseline: Multiple outlets (Reuters, FT, Guardian, NY Post, Yahoo Finance) report that about 20 Goldman executives are set to receive special equity awards worth more than $500 million, finalized later in October 2026, with CEO David Solomon expected to receive the largest slice (~$100 million).
clip_research.surprise_gap: The transcript frames the award as an unintended expansion: it was designed in 2021 for only the top two or three executives but was broadened to roughly 20 after shareholder and employee pushback, turning a narrow retention grant into a >$500 million pool.

evidence.fact: Goldman's top executives are poised to collect special bonuses totaling more than $500 million.
The award was put in place in 2021 and was only supposed to be for the top two or three executives, but after pushback the board expanded it to roughly 20 executives.
The Goldman board had docked $10 million from David Solomon's pay over the 1MDB bribery scandal.

evidence.fact: Reuters: Goldman's top executives are set to receive special equity awards worth more than $500 million.

evidence.fact: Sina Finance: about 20 Goldman executives are expected to receive equity awards worth over $500 million at current share prices.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim the bonus pool has already been paid out; reports say it is expected to be finalized later in October 2026.
Do not state that David Solomon's exact award is confirmed at $100 million; that figure comes from FT reporting and is described as expected.
Do not assert the 1MDB scandal caused the bonus expansion; the transcript only says the pay dock and the expansion both occurred.
Do not claim Goldman Sachs admitted wrongdoing in this clip.

notes: The clip is a Bloomberg segment; the speaker is a Bloomberg correspondent, so the opinion-holding actor is the media source, not Goldman Sachs.
Chinese media commonly use both 苏德巍 and 大卫·所罗门 for David Solomon; 苏德巍 is the established Chinese name and is preferred for titles.
The 1MDB Chinese label is not directly verified by the provided snippets; confidence is medium.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力

经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
